component: Temporary exact-candidate verification environment and lint comparator
description: The first isolated attempt had no Git history for two existing report preservation tests, and Turbopack rejected a node_modules symlink outside its filesystem root. The initial lint comparator also treated two unchanged warning statements shifted by the accepted 16-line capture wrapper as new warnings.

report_errors: fatal: not a git repository (or any of the parent directories): .git
Symlink [project]/node_modules is invalid, it points out of the filesystem root

repair: Root attached local Git metadata with the parent commit and read-only alternate historical objects, without remotes.
Root replaced only the temporary node_modules symlink with an APFS clone of the same installed dependencies; no dependency install or update.
The checker now compares warning path, rule, message and exact source line with multiplicity. Source-identical displaced warnings retain their before/after positions.

unchanged_warning_evidence.message: 'key' is assigned a value but never used.
'yahooSymbol' is assigned a value but never used.
